State what remains trusted after this stage: which obligations are discharged, which are declared and unproved, and which rest on a named assumption. blocks is a liveness claim and this project proves no liveness. Handler atomicity is a platform assumption. The crash model is a per-device input. Each gets written where a reader meets it, not in an appendix.

```day-atom
{"in":["gate-result"],"out":["trust-statement"],"next":["upstream-file"]}
```
